returned_tweets.text: Demis Hassabis calls today's approach brute-force duct tape for AI memory: 1 million tokens sounds like unlimited AI memory but feeding an agent raw live video, that context can be gone in about 20 minutes.

returned_tweets.text: Dario Amodei says AI companies like Anthropic may need to be taxed to pay for the employment crisis they're creating. Entry-level white-collar jobs could be replaced within 1 to 5 years

returned_tweets.author: CNN
returned_tweets.text: When biologists experiment on dangerous viruses, they do so under strict regulations. But no such rules exist to prevent AI agents from similarly escaping - even though the consequences could be catastrophic.

returned_tweets.text: ELON MUSK: The Anthropic team left OpenAI because they didn't trust Sam Altman. He said otherwise Anthropic wouldn't exist, calling Dario Amodei a very principled person.

returned_tweets.text: Congratulations @KanishkaNarayan on your new role as UK's AI Minister in the Cabinet, great news for the UK AI ecosystem!

returned_tweets.author: the_vc_intern
returned_tweets.text: Cognition just acquired a roughly 10-person startup that went from 500,000 messages during its beta to more than 100 million messages in the last three months. Poke is also the only AI agent Apple has approved to text natively inside Messages.

returned_tweets.text: I have tracked 16 math problems recently solved by AI. 9 solved by counterexample: 56.3%. 7 solved by proof: 43.8%. 10 of 16 have formal proofs: 62.5%.
